name: agent-harness
description: Agent harness runtime-reconfiguration design and evaluation plus Codex and Claude runtime operations, secret-safe human credential handoff, 1Password, sessions, deferred completion, and scheduler proof.

interface.shortDescription: Build, evaluate, operate, and prove agent runtimes.
interface.longDescription: Design and evaluate reliable LLM agent harnesses, including contracts and evidence gates for versioned runtime reconfiguration and rollback; operate Codex CLI and Claude Code; hand task-scoped credentials from a human or 1Password directly to target processes without returning secret values to the model; manage plugins, MCP servers, hooks, settings, sessions, worktrees, and environments; inspect rollout evidence; use producer-native deferred completion; and prove local operating-system scheduler runs.
capabilities: Vendor-neutral agent harness design with typed control, runtime-generation and reconfiguration contracts, state, policy, recovery, cancellation, and delegation
Harness evaluation, replay, mixed-generation fault injection, rollback evidence, failure attribution, reliability analysis, and release gates
Codex CLI inspection, exec and review automation, diagnostics, environments, plugins, MCP, task supervision, and rollout forensics
Claude Code inspection, print automation, diagnostics, hooks, settings, agents, worktrees, sessions, plugins, and MCP
Secret-safe operator and 1Password credential handoff through native prompts and bounded receipts
Producer-native deferred completion receipts through a bundled MCP server
Local launchd, systemd timer, cron, and Windows Task Scheduler runtime proof
defaultPrompt: Route this agent harness or Codex/Claude runtime task to the narrowest safe workflow and verify the result.
